definitions.explanation: A person who smokes tobacco, especially as a habit. A somewhat formal term used in health and public-policy contexts.

examples.japanese: {喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of smokers is decreasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれている→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has separate seating for smokers.

examples.japanese: {喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The proportion of smokers has been falling year by year.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ (smoking) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A formal term common in health statistics, surveys, and rules about smoking areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧: the number of smokers decreases
- {喫煙者|きつえんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: the proportion of smokers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {非喫煙者|ひきつえんしゃ}: non-smoker
- ⟦たばこ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: "a person who smokes" — the everyday spoken equivalent; {喫煙者|きつえんしゃ} is the formal, written term
